title: Spatial State, History, Era & Event Change
objective: Let governed Events alter routes, structures, access, migration, sanctuaries, research sites and spatial availability across eras while preserving history, canonical owner authority and the distinction between spatial semantics and live state without creating duplicate World or event ledgers.
governed_start_requirements: A future owner Continue is required before SSA-08 governed start or application source mutation.

Re-read the current SSA program/backlog, this checkpoint, completed SSA-01 through SSA-07 surfaces, and canonical World/Reality, Event, Scene, MAI, ISE, Exploration, Research, Creature ecology, Project, Permission/entitlement and provider/media-rights contracts.
Resolve exact governed event-to-spatial-change families for routes, structures, access, migration, sanctuaries, research sites and spatial availability across eras while preserving history.

Keep geometry, semantic structure, topology, historical state and live owner state distinct; SSA-08 may project owner-governed changes but cannot become a second World, Event, Reality, navigation, ecology, Research or credential ledger.
Preserve permission filtering, hidden/GM-only cardinality protection, provenance and accessible nonvisual equivalents for consequential era/state changes.
Decide whether durable SSA-08 persistence is genuinely required during governed start; no migration is reserved at selection.

Register exactly one SSA-08 current-family Validation Core profile with zero predecessor fanout and create/register an exact-baseline implementation branch from application main 61ff10cd825f925caf6f898e03f623c87be73ca7 only after a green merged governed start.
preserved_boundaries: SSA-01 through SSA-07 remain completed_verified with retired implementation authority.

World/Reality and Event owners remain authoritative for live and historical event state; Scene, MAI, ISE, Exploration, Research, Creature ecology, Project, Permission/entitlement and provider/media-rights owners remain canonical.
SSA-08 selection grants no implementation branch, source mutation, persistence, provider activation or migration authority.
Event-linked spatial projections cannot silently mutate canonical owner state or erase historical state.
Functional-zone or route changes cannot replace Creature ecology, World/Reality, Exploration or Research authority.
Research-site changes cannot replace Research progression, Project, credential/access-control, hazard or information ownership.
Hidden/GM-only spatial history and protected cardinality remain filtered before player/accessibility/diagnostic/export/AI projection.
Accessible nonvisual history/state equivalents remain required for consequential spatial change.
SSA-09+, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
next_action: Wait for a future owner Continue. Then governed-start SSA-08 from exact application main 61ff10cd825f925caf6f898e03f623c87be73ca7 and execute only the bounded spatial-state, history, era and event-change tranche after AIOC Repository Health passes.
